steps.content:
I'd pick **Ottervale Audio (seller B)**, but only by a small margin.

The two listings match on almost everything:
- **Price:** $129.00 at both.
- **Shipping:** free standard shipping, arriving in 3 to 5 business days.
- **Returns:** 30 days, you pay return shipping, and the refund goes to your original payment method.
- **Warranty:** 1-year limited warranty at both.
- **Product and specs:** the same model, color (graphite) and contents.
- **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 from 210 reviews on both. The identical count suggests the reviews may be shared product reviews and not feedback on each seller.

The one difference is that Ottervale says it is an **authorized Quellwyn dealer with the full manufacturer warranty**. Brackmoor Sound doesn't say it is authorized. Buying from an authorized dealer lowers the risk of gray-market or counterfeit stock. It also makes it more likely the manufacturer will honor the warranty. Brackmoor may well be legitimate, but its listing gives you no way to confirm that.

Ottervale's listing also says "full manufacturer warranty" while the warranty section says "1-year limited warranty." That is probably the same thing, but check the warranty terms before you buy if it matters to you.

I could only see the two listing pages. I couldn't check the sellers' reputations, so a quick look at independent seller reviews would be worth doing. If Brackmoor turned out to be cheaper at checkout or had better seller reviews, that could change my answer. Going by the listings alone, Ottervale is the safer choice at no extra cost.
